notes: Retained from the source slide; not found as a deployment tool in the inspected demos.
Infrastructure creation and server configuration; the 03c/03d/03e variants retain Ansible for infrastructure.
Resource provisioning and state management; also executes synthesized CDK Terrain output.
Machine image builds. Scores: rebuilds a new image each run rather than converging one; provisioners are scripts; parallel builds and cleanup on failure but no plan or state; no module system.

Masterless Puppet configuration using the OpenVox distribution. Scores: idempotent resource model and a compiled, dependency-ordered catalog; noop preview; agent mode re-enforces state; modules, Hiera and the Forge. Masterless use as in the demo, so no PuppetDB queries.

Remote orchestration using OpenBolt; upstream Bolt is documented as an alternative. Scores: plans and tasks are imperative steps, only apply blocks are declarative; concurrent agentless runs without plan or reconciliation; reuses Puppet modules.

Chef Infra local mode using the Cinc client distribution. Scores: idempotent resources inside ordered Ruby recipes; compile-then-converge with why-run preview; cookbooks with versioned dependencies. Local mode as in the demo, so no Chef search.

Salt states applied with salt-ssh; masterless salt-call is also documented. Scores: idempotent states with requisites; grains, pillar and targeting give strong queries; test=True preview; formulas lack versioned packaging; documentation is hard to navigate.

Python infrastructure definitions synthesized for Terraform execution. Scores: inherits Terraform plan/apply; Python program generates the declarations; constructs and Python packages for reuse; young fork with thin documentation and unreadable synthesized JSON.

Infrastructure definitions and deployment using Python. Scores: desired-state engine with preview and refresh; declarations built by a Python program; lookups usable in code; component resources and language packages; typed SDK documentation.

Machine initialization; image building waits for initialization to finish. Scores: cloud-config is declarative but modules run once per instance and runcmd is imperative; fixed boot stages, no preview; instance-data queries only; schema validation and module reference.

Kubernetes package manager; not used in the inspected demos. Scores: upgrade --install converges a release, but hooks are imperative; values plus Go templates render manifests; lookup is the only cluster query; release history, rollback and --atomic but no built-in diff; versioned charts with dependencies; values schema and helm show values.
